title: Primary math: money and budget
description: Four life-skills lessons: coin values, making change, planning a budget, and transferring to real shopping situations.
assumptions: Whole-yuan amounts; coins 1/5/10 yuan, notes 20/50/100 yuan.
stage2goal: Plan budgets and transfer to shopping.
coin-values.title: Coin and note values
coin-values.goal: Combine coin values to a total.
coin-values.reading: Coins 1/5/10 yuan add by value: 5+5+1=11 yuan. Count by value, not by number of coins.
coin-values.worked.prompt: Why do two 5-yuan coins and one 1-yuan coin make 11 yuan?
making-change.title: Making change
making-change.reading: Change is what returns: paid minus price. Pay 20 for 13 → change 7.
making-change.struggle: Without computing, explain why change = paid − price, not price − paid.
making-change.worked.prompt: Why is change paid minus price?
making-change.worked.fb: You get back the extra you paid.
making-change.c1.a.label: subtraction
making-change.c1.b.label: addition
budget-plan.title: Plan a budget
budget-plan.goal: Check a purchase list against a budget.
budget-plan.reading: A budget caps total spending: sum the list, compare to the cap; over cap means remove or swap items.
budget-plan.transfer-budget.a.label: Buy all anyway
budget-plan.transfer-budget.b.label: Remove or swap an item
budget-plan.c1.a.label: sum ≤ cap
budget-plan.c1.b.label: sum > cap
shopping-transfer.title: Real shopping transfer
shopping-transfer.goal: Combine total, change and budget in one situation.
shopping-transfer.reading: Real shopping chains the skills: sum the list, check the budget, pay, then compute change.
shopping-transfer.worked.prompt: List 12+13=25, budget 30, pay 50: what is change?
shopping-transfer.c1.a.label: sum the list
shopping-transfer.c1.b.label: compute change
shopping-transfer.c2.a.label: change to cap
shopping-transfer.c2.b.label: total to cap
